preReview.title: Richter tells Philadelphia to stay focused ahead of Sporting KC test
preReview.description: Philadelphia Union are looking to extend a 10-match unbeaten run in MLS when they visit lowly Sporting Kansas City on Saturday.

preReview.description: Philadelphia Union busca ampliar a 11 partidos su racha invicta en la MLS en su visita del sábado al colista Sporting Kansas City.

preReview.title: Richter cobra concentração do Philadelphia antes do duelo com o Sporting KC
preReview.description: Philadelphia Union tenta ampliar sequência invicta de dez jogos na MLS em visita ao lanterna Sporting Kansas City no sábado.

preReview.title: Richter invita Philadelphia a non perdere la concentrazione contro Sporting KC

preReview.description: Le Philadelphia Union veut prolonger sa série de dix matches sans défaite en MLS lors de son déplacement chez la lanterne rouge, le Sporting Kansas City, samedi.

preReview.title: Richter fordert vor dem Duell mit Sporting KC volle Konzentration
preReview.description: Philadelphia Union will seine Serie von zehn ungeschlagenen MLS-Spielen am Samstag beim Tabellenletzten Sporting Kansas City ausbauen.
